statement_id: KTOWER refutation of Soule 2003 Lemma 9 (cp11; refined bound p <= 1+rN)
who: Claude Opus 5.5 at effort high, AG_POLISH cluster reader (intake pile 24 Nov)
outcome: Q(sqrt(-7)) is the quadratic subfield of Q(zeta_7), so Z[zeta_7] is a torsion-free O_F-module of rank 3, free since h(Q(sqrt(-7)))=1; multiplication by zeta_7 is an element of order 7 in GL_3(O_F), while 1+sup(r,N)=1+sup(2,3)=4 < 7. The counterexample holds; 7 <= 1+rN = 7 is consistent with the refined bound
